preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 2 and 105, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and 105, inclusive.
Each edge connects two distinct vertices with vertex ai being less than vertex bi.
Each edge has a unique color between 1 and m, inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 105, inclusive.
Each query vertex is between 1 and n, inclusive, and ui is not equal to vi.

postconditions.expression: For each query (ui, vi), the output is the number of unique colors that connect ui and vi directly or indirectly.
postconditions.description: The output for each query is the count of distinct colors that can be used to reach vertex vi from vertex ui through any sequence of edges of the same color.
